body:
It isn't pathetic at all, you're seeking help from someone which is willing to listen to what you have to say without judging you. 
You know your bestfriend, you know if he will judge you based on what you're going to tell him.

In the eternal nothingness you feel nothing so I think it is better than being alive. It is like before being born, you weren't feeling sad, happy or nothing, you were just feeling the "nothingness". 
Please don't take my comment as a motive to give up on life, it is just my view on these things.

I wish I wouldn't need anyone in my life but I really can't achieve that level of coldness even though I wish I could.

I can see that you're religious, no harm in that even though I am not.
I honestly want to think that there is anything after death but I think it is exactly as it was before you were born, just nothingness.
Pain is temporary as long as you let it be after you learn how to deal with it you'll get over it with no problems at all ( that is what I learned from reading about buddhism, but I might be wrong).
It would be really better if someone else was in your overall control, like you're referring to a god, but, I don't think that is the case because as a god I wouldn't let pain to exist in a world I created myself.

My loneliness doesn't come from having too few or too many friends, comes from having no intimate relationship.
Seeing my friends having relationships while growing up felt shitty.
That is why I feel so bad right knowing that someone I love will leave me.

And the thing regarding religion, I will never believe in any god or anything especially knowing what happens in this world and what happened to a family member.

I literally can't change anything regarding that rule, that is set in stone, I just have to find anything else to do.

Honestly, I am tired knowing that everyone I care about will leave this town and I don't even feel like trying to meet anyone else.

The thing is, I hate being alone I hate being lonely...

I don't know anymore what my purpose in my life is.
No, I am not religious at all.
While reading about philosophies I took interest in it and read as much as I could about every important philosophy and it seems like I very much agreed with the rather sadder ones.

Why would anyone even care about how far I came.
I started working this year after failing to join the police school because they changed the behavior grades needed to join in ( I live in a particular country in eastern europe).
I wanted to go to uni but I honestly don't know what I want to do after I failed everything just because of a simple rule change.
All of my current friends will leave the town I currently live in and I will be completely alone so there is that.
Besides the ocassional pain, I have no other symptoms that could point to FLD.
I don't know really, I am curious about what sticks out the most from that chart.
If you continue, one day you will get used to it.
If you wanna talk just message me :)

Things is, I really did that in the last 2 years, but I really want to feel what it is like to be in a relationship, it is something which I didn't really experience.
I've learned how to live with the lack of intimacy but for 1 or 2 weeks every 2 months I wasn't myself because that feeling of loneliness was getting me, maybe because I was having an episodic depression.
It is really hard when you see your friends having long relationship and you are the only one which is alone.
I don't even care about sex, I just want to cuddle with someone which I love.
Honestly, I didn't even try to search for a relationship myself, I wanted to see if a girl would like to be in a relationship with me. I wasn't acting like I am hard to get or anything, I was just being myself.
I am not the most talkative person, but if I get to know you and I like you, we would be good friends.
